turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to stop buying coffee every morning and make it at home instead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good plan, you'll save a lot. Do you want something simple like a French press, or are you ready to invest in an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Jordan for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you care if we stay in a hotel or would you rather rent an apartment?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Apartment, if it has a kitchen. Eating out every night gets expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True. But hotels usually have breakfast included.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We can buy croissants. Honestly I just want a balcony.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ha, okay, balcony and kitchen. I'll filter for that.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: And not too far from the train station please, with all our bags.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. You were choosing how to make coffee at home, a press or an espresso machine?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Espresso. I mostly drink lattes, so I might as well.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then get one with a steam wand for the milk. It'll pay for itself in a few months.
